task.title: Relics: `relic update --link` reports the new link's ID
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M40). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

`workbook relic update --link` prints no link ID, in text or in JSON. The docs tell the reader to find it with `relic show`.

## Wanted

Report the ID of each link the update added.

## Done when

- Text and JSON output name each new link's ID.
- The reference documents the member.
